tickerText: [TENNIS] Tsitsipas and Swiss wild card Jerome Kym resume their Gstaad second-round thriller at 5-5 in the third set Thursday after darkness halted play — Roman Andres Burruchaga's shock win over world No. 9 Flavio Cobolli reshapes the Umag draw as quarterfinals loom at Bastad and Gstaad • [SQUASH] HCL Chennai PSA Challenger crowns Joachim Chuah and Rouqaia Othman — the Malaysian top seed beat Adham Roshdy in straight games while Othman rallied from two games down to edge Hwayeong Eum in five • [BADMINTON] Japan Open Super 750 Round of 16: PV Sindhu stunned world No. 5 Han Yue 21-16, 21-14 as India's lone survivor — top seed An Se-young withdrew, sending Nozomi Okuhara through to the quarters • [PICKLEBALL] PPA250 Melbourne is live at Raya and Pickle4Real with 405 players — Thursday's pro qualifiers kick off a four-day event ahead of the Macon PPA Challenger July 17–19 • [TABLE TENNIS] WTT Youth Contender Ulaanbaatar Day 3: U11, U15 and U19 singles continue at Mongolia's first ITTF world-ranking events — the WTT Feeder follows July 19–23

newsItems.title: Tsitsipas-Kym Gstaad Thriller Resumes at 5-5
newsItems.excerpt: Stefanos Tsitsipas and Swiss wild card Jerome Kym resume their EFG Swiss Open second-round clash Thursday at 5-5 in the decider after darkness halted play Wednesday. Tsitsipas leads 6-4, 6-7(2) without facing a break point as the post-Wimbledon clay swing continues at Bastad, Gstaad and Umag.

newsItems.title: Chuah and Othman Crowned at Chennai PSA Challenger
newsItems.excerpt: Malaysia's Joachim Chuah beat Egypt's Adham Roshdy 12-10, 11-7, 11-8 for the men's title, while top seed Rouqaia Othman rallied from two games down to edge Korea's Hwayeong Eum 11-6, 10-12, 19-21, 11-7, 11-8 at the HCL Squash PSA Challenger in Chennai.

newsItems.title: PPA250 Melbourne Kicks Off with Pro Qualifiers
newsItems.excerpt: The PPA Tour Australia 250 Melbourne began Thursday at Raya Pickleball Club and Pickle4Real with 405 players registered, opening with pro qualifiers and singles ahead of championship Sunday. The Macon PPA Challenger follows July 17–19 in Georgia.

newsItems.title: WTT Youth Ulaanbaatar Shifts to U11, U15 and U19 Singles
newsItems.excerpt: Day three of the WTT Youth Contender Ulaanbaatar brings U11, U15 and U19 singles at the Buyant-Ukhaa Sports Complex, part of Mongolia's debut ITTF world-ranking events with 300-plus athletes from 30 nations. The WTT Feeder begins July 19.
